info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Plans-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Plans API provides users with the ability to retrieve a list of available utility billing plans offered by the service provider. This endpoint is designed for developers working on customer account management systems, billing applications, or any service integration needing to access billing plan information. Consumers can use this API to obtain detailed plan options, including pricing and features, enabling effective decision-making for customers selecting utility services. Enhance your user's experience with comprehensive billing solutions through this vital resource.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their current billing plan details, providing essential information about the plan's features and pricing structure.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the billing plan. It should contain the necessary details required to fetch the specific billing plan requested.

201.description: Successfully retrieved the billing plan details.
